scope.note: TASK-N1-O6 pilot. Coverage is declared per FAMILY and joined against e2e/matrix/targets.generated.ts, so a component added to a covered family is covered without editing this file. Components outside these families read `not-covered` in the capability matrix - an explicit state, never `unknown`. PLATFORM: baselines are platform-locked by construction - Playwright writes `{arg}-{project}-{platform}.png`, so a linux baseline and a win32 baseline are different files and are never compared to each other. `platform` is the one this ledger gates on; `ciPlatform` is what .github/workflows/ci.yml runs. They currently DISAGREE: the pilot was captured on win32 and no linux baseline for it exists, so the per-component lane is developer-local evidence and is not yet a CI gate. Promoting it is one accept run per snapshot on a linux host - an owner action, recorded in the N1-O6 handoff.
